bio.text: John Stegner is an independent candidate for governor of Idaho in 2026 and a retired Idaho Supreme Court justice.
He was appointed a district judge in Latah County in 1997, was appointed to the Idaho Supreme Court by Gov. Butch Otter in 2018, and retired from the court in 2023.
He was born and raised in Grangeville and practiced law in Lewiston before becoming a judge in Moscow.

sources.title: Independent John Stegner launches campaign for Idaho governor
